messages.author: 0f34271218fb0da4
messages.subject: Error_Loading_CELSet
parts:
Hi,

Following the Total CNV Analysis I loaded all annotation Files with no
problem. However, when I run the "AffymetrixCelSet$fromName" function
it prompts the error:

"""
>> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("primera_prova", chipType="GenomeWideSNP_6")
Error in list("AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("primera_prova", chipType =
"GenomeWideSNP_6")" = <environment>, :

[2008-04-24 11:54:22] Exception: Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile
object. No CDF file with that chip type found: GenomeWideSNP_6
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Could not create ", class(static)[1], " object. No
CDF file with that chip type found: ", chipType)
at throw("Could not create ", class(static)[1], " object. No CDF
file with that chip type found: ", chipType)
at method(static, ...)
at AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType(chipType)
at method(this, ...)
at static$fromFiles(path = path, cdf = cdf, ...)
at withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w)
invokeRestart("muffleWarning"))
at suppressWarnings({
at byName.AffymetrixCelSet(static, ...)
at byName(static, ...)
at method(static, ...)
at AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("primera_prova", chipType =
"GenomeWideSNP_6")
"""


- It would seem as it does not find the previously loaded CDF file,
but when I run it seems to be OK:
"""
>>print(cdf)
AffymetrixCdfFile:
Path: annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6
Filename: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf
Filesize: 470.44MB
File format: v4 (binary; XDA)
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full
Dimension: 2572x2680
Number of cells: 6892960
Number of units: 1881415
Cells per unit: 3.66
Number of QC units: 4
RAM: 0.01MB
"""

I checked the path and it seems to be OK:
"""
>>cdf$findByChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full")
"annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6/GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf"
"""

Also, It takes ~5 minutes to prompt the error (if it would be a
pathname error, shouldn't it show sooner?).

Thank you very much for your help,

Toni

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error_Loading_CELSet
parts:
On Thu, Apr 24, 2008 at 12:11 PM, toni_julia <julia...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
>
> Hi,
>
> Following the Total CNV Analysis I loaded all annotation Files with no
> problem.

Which document is 'Total CNV Analysis', because I think/guess you are
looking at the wrong document. Please see the Vignette 'Total Copy
Number Analysis (5.0 & 6.0)', You basically want to use the
construct:

cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("primera_prova", cdf=cdf)

> However, when I run the "AffymetrixCelSet$fromName" function
> it prompts the error:
>
> """
> >> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("primera_prova", chipType="GenomeWideSNP_6")
> Error in list("AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("primera_prova", chipType =
> "GenomeWideSNP_6")" = <environment>, :
>
> [2008-04-24 11:54:22] Exception: Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile
> object. No CDF file with that chip type found: GenomeWideSNP_6
> at throw(Exception(...))
> at throw.default("Could not create ", class(static)[1], " object. No
> CDF file with that chip type found: ", chipType)
> at throw("Could not create ", class(static)[1], " object. No CDF
> file with that chip type found: ", chipType)
> at method(static, ...)
> at AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType(chipType)
> at method(this, ...)
> at static$fromFiles(path = path, cdf = cdf, ...)
> at withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w)
> invokeRestart("muffleWarning"))
> at suppressWarnings({
> at byName.AffymetrixCelSet(static, ...)
> at byName(static, ...)
> at method(static, ...)
> at AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("primera_prova", chipType =
> "GenomeWideSNP_6")
> """

The reason is that it tries to locate the GenomeWideSNP_6.cdf file,
which you do not have (in the search path at least).

>
>
> - It would seem as it does not find the previously loaded CDF file,
> but when I run it seems to be OK:
> """
> >>print(cdf)
> AffymetrixCdfFile:
> Path: annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6
> Filename: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf
> Filesize: 470.44MB
> File format: v4 (binary; XDA)
> Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full
> Dimension: 2572x2680
> Number of cells: 6892960
> Number of units: 1881415
> Cells per unit: 3.66
> Number of QC units: 4
> RAM: 0.01MB
> """
Note that this is the GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf and not the GenomeWideSNP_6.cdf.

>
> I checked the path and it seems to be OK:
> """
> >>cdf$findByChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full")
> "annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6/GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf"
> """

Although not wrong, just curious, where did you find out about the
construct cdf$findByChipType()?

>
> Also, It takes ~5 minutes to prompt the error (if it would be a
> pathname error, shouldn't it show sooner?).

I do not know why that is, but it could be because there are a lot of
directories (including recursive subdirectories) that are scanned. I
have not experienced this.

/Henrik

>
> Thank you very much for your help,
>
> Toni
>
>
>
